business_summary: Nissou Co.,Ltd. provides renovation services for real estate properties. It operates through three segments: Renovation Business, Real Estate Distribution Business, and Real Estate Construction Business. The Renovation Business includes restoration work, renovation work, house cleaning, and maintenance during occupancy. The Real Estate Distribution Business engages in the buying and selling of real estate, brokerage, and purchasing and resale of real estate. The Real Estate Construction Business is primarily involved in the design, construction, and sales of custom-built and pre-built homes, primarily detached houses. Nissou Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Setagaya, Japan.
